rows.en:
(Today I'm going to see Ranka's concert
with Shirakawa!)
(I wish Shirakawa would hurry up and get here.)
Sorry to keep you waiting, \p-kun.
I just got here myself.

Really? Oh, good.
I didn't want to keep you waiting again!
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; recalls the 30-minute wait in frd_myk_007.

rows.en:
Come on, Ranka-san's concert is about to start!
Let's go!!

H-hey!
Don't pull me!!

Oh, honestly! Here we are,
finally holding hands, and...
rows.notes: Male, Miyuki, muttering; sekkaku te o tsunaideru noni.

rows.en: Hm? What?
Mmm~ Nothing!
Haah~ That was so much fun~!

That's the first time I've ever seen you
get so excited, Shirakawa.

You were swinging your glow stick around too!
You have to think about the people around you!
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki, now casual with the player; penlight = glow stick.

rows.en:
But it really was so much fun~
And not just because it was Ranka-san's
concert, but, um...
I'm really glad I got to see it with you...
I want to go see her again.

Yeah, I want to see her again and again.
Watching her concerts makes me feel like
I can keep trying my best.

I guess this is what they mean when they say
someone gives you strength.
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders; pawaa o morau.

rows.en:
I wish I could give someone strength
like that, too...
Mm-mm, it's nothing.
So, um, about after this...

If you'd like, why don't you come over
to my place again? This time I'll make
the food...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; 'again' = the player's visit when she was sick (frd_myk_007).

rows.en:
Oh yeah? Well, since you're offering,
I think I will!
rows.notes: Male; sekkaku dashi, ojama shiyou kana.

rows.en: Yeah! Then let's go!!

(The concert was fun,
Shirakawa's cooking was delicious...
What a perfect change of pace!!)

(Today I'm going to see Ranka-chan's concert
with Miyuki!)
(I wish Miyuki would hurry up and get here~)
Sorry to keep you waiting, \p-san.
Nope, I just got here too.

Ah, hey!
Don't pull me~!!
Haah~ That was so much fun~!
rows.notes: Female, Miyuki (full-width space in the Japanese, no meaning).

rows.en:
That's the first time I've ever seen you
get so excited, Miyuki.
It really was great, wasn't it?
Yeah, since you're offering, I think I will!

(The concert was fun,
Miyuki's cooking was delicious...
What a perfect change of pace~!!)

(Today's the extra show Ranka added
to her concert run.)
rows.notes: Male; tsuika kouen = an added performance.

rows.en:
(I've gotta thank Shirakawa's parents
for getting us tickets for today, too.)
You're late, \p-kun.
Sorry, sorry, the train was packed...
Making excuses isn't cool, you know...

Don't be mad. I was so excited
I could barely get to sleep.
rows.notes: Male; she takes it as excitement about her (c11002).

rows.en:
Huh?
E-excited?!

I mean, it's not every day you get
to go to a Ranka concert! Let me thank
your parents next time, okay?

Y-yes, well, sure...
......What's with you? Idiot...
rows.notes: Male, Miyuki, muttering (nani yo, baka); kept at full strength.

rows.en: Hm? Something wrong?

I wouldn't know!
Come on, let's go!!
I said don't pull me~

That was great, huh...
Seikan Hikou for the encore...
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders. Song title from the glossary (songs).

rows.en: I want to come see her again and again.

If we can get tickets, let's come
as many times as we want.
I mean... the two of us, together.
...Yeah!
Well then, shall we go home together?

(Shirakawa's in a great mood,
and I got a nice change of pace.)

(Today's the extra show Ranka-chan added
to her concert run.)

(I've gotta thank Miyuki's parents
for getting us tickets for today, too.)
You're late, \p-san.

Ahahaha... That just shows how much
I was looking forward to it!

I could hardly sleep either.
I was too excited.

It's not every day you get to go
to a Ranka-chan concert. Let me thank
your parents next time, okay?

You don't need to worry about it.
I'm the one who begged them for the tickets...
I can't just leave it at that~!

Now, the doors are about to open,
so let's go!

(Miyuki's in a great mood,
and I got a nice change of pace~)

uncertain: c10996/c11014: tsuika kouen rendered 'the extra show ... added to her concert run'.
